title: L12 / C10: one-time migration 146 runbook and transaction failures
public_pr_body:
Adds docs/handover/C10-146-ONE-TIME-MIGRATION-RUNBOOK.md: run the complete file once under separate authority, verify immediately, stop on error/uncertain commit, never auto-rollback after live use and never reinstall after rollback.

Pins BEGIN/COMMIT and line 37 ADD COLUMN key_source. Explains that its existing-column error aborts the current transaction, so preceding pending table/seed changes cannot commit, while pre-existing committed history/column survive; split/autocommitting execution requires separate investigation. Covers later error, connection loss around COMMIT, verification failure and retained-history/reservation recovery limits.

Exact immutable file/line citations, source ordering, 237-line release/rollback and whitespace checked. Handover embedded. Documentation only; no runtime recovery claim, source SQL changes, main merge, production SQL, deployment or Ready label.
